# synaptics-009b-fprintd

> Autonomous Linux user-space driver and drop-in `fprintd` D-Bus service for the Synaptics Prometheus `06cb:009b` (MSI SecurePad) fingerprint sensor.

## Context
- **Problem:** For over 5 years (since 2019), the Synaptics `06cb:009b` fingerprint sensor was marked by upstream `libfprint` as "unlikely to ever be supported". It uses Match-on-Host (MoH) architecture with TLS 1.2 ECDH (P-256) encryption and Die Type-2 silicon. Existing tools like `python-validity` only supported Die Type-1 (`009a`, `0097`) via polled `0x51` commands, which causes hardware faults and infinite reboot loops on `009b`.
- **Solution:** A high-performance user-space driver stack featuring a pure Rust core (`syna-tool`) with native EP `0x82` frames-sync stream capture, host-side QuantumMatcher neural minutiae matching, and a drop-in D-Bus daemon (`syna-fprintd`) implementing standard `net.reactivated.Fprint.Manager` and `net.reactivated.Fprint.Device` interfaces.
- **System Integration:** Fully compatible with standard Linux fingerprint utilities (`fprintd-enroll`, `fprintd-verify`, `fprintd-list`), `pam_fprintd.so` (`sudo`, Polkit, SDDM, Hyprland/GNOME/KDE lock screens), and systemd suspend/resume hooks.
- **Non-Destructive & Autonomous:** Extracts pairing data offline, preserving Windows Hello functionality in dual-boot setups. The installer downloads the official 1.2 MB driver CAB directly from Microsoft Update Catalog to carve neural weights without requiring Windows.

## Hardware Support
- **Sensor:** Synaptics Prometheus `06cb:009b` (MSI SecurePad), Die Type-2 (`0x2449`).
- **Verified Working Laptops:**
  - MSI PS63 Modern (8RC, 8RD, 8M)
  - MSI Modern 14 / Modern 15
  - MSI Prestige 14 / Prestige 15
  - MSI Creator 15
  - MSI GS66 Stealth
  - Any laptop equipped with the Synaptics `06cb:009b` USB sensor.

## Key Files
- [README.md](README.md): Comprehensive documentation, hardware compatibility matrix, installation guides, and troubleshooting FAQ.
- [install.sh](install.sh): Autonomous installer that downloads driver CAB from Microsoft Update Catalog, extracts neural weights, compiles Rust binaries, and installs systemd/udev/PAM configs.
- [aur/](aur/): Official Arch Linux packaging files (`PKGBUILD`, `.SRCINFO`, `synaptics-009b-fprintd.install`) providing a systemd drop-in override for `fprintd.service`.
- [synaptics-prometheus/](synaptics-prometheus/): Core driver crate handling USB transport (`nusb`), TLS session establishment, stream arming, and frame reconstruction.
- [synaptics-prometheus-qm/](synaptics-prometheus-qm/): Reverse-engineered host-side QuantumMatcher engine executing minutiae extraction and template matching.
- [daemon/syna-fprintd](daemon/syna-fprintd): Python D-Bus daemon serving `net.reactivated.Fprint` interfaces with automatic client disconnect cleanup.
- [daemon/synaptics-009b](daemon/synaptics-009b): Systemd sleep hook managing clean sensor release and post-resume re-enumeration.
